name: Zenith DevTools
description: Developer tools for Zenith Framework — Signal Inspector, Timeline, Components, Effects, v1.0 Features (zen-static, Resource.destroy, cache stats, SSR stores), Graph Viewer.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
